title: Aquarium Feeding and Temperature Risk Overlap
app: Fi collar, Petkit, Tractive, Petlibro, Litter-Robot, pet cameras, and aquarium controllers via vendor exports, Home Assistant integrations, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=aquarium:sensor
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count(eval(feeding_event=1)) as feedings, max(water_temp_c) as max_water_temp_c by tank _time
| where feedings=0 OR max_water_temp_c>29
| sort - max_water_temp_c
description: Uses Aquarium pet-care telemetry telemetry to monitor days when fish care and tank temperature both looked risky in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for overlooked feedings or overheating before livestock are stressed, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Aquarium pet-care telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Daily tank table of feedings and peak water temperature.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers days when fish care and tank temperature both looked risky so you can spot overlooked feedings or overheating before livestock are stressed before it becomes annoying.
